auditor.elise: Hi all — I need a concise, reproducible evidence export for three scenarios: (A) RBAC change, (B) KMS key rotation, (C) vulnerability→incident. Please include exact commands you run, canonical S3 paths where artifacts land, signing/checksum steps, retention/immutability notes, and which SOC2/ISO controls each artifact satisfies.

maria.chen: For RBAC (A) — minimal commands: 
terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "PutRolePolicy|AttachRolePolicy|UpdateAssumeRolePolicy" --start-time 1700000000000 --end-time 1700000360000 > /tmp/iam_events.json
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/rolebindings.yaml
Upload to s3://audit-exports/rbac/{ticket}/{ts}/ and create manifest: sha256sum * > manifest.txt ; gpg --local-user maria@redwood --armor --detach-sign manifest.txt
Maps to: SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.3 (change proof + approvers).

aj.kapoor: For KMS rotation (B) — commands: 
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-data > /tmp/key_meta.json
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-data --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "RotateKey|DisableKey|ScheduleKeyDeletion" --start-time 1700000000000 --end-time 1700000360000 > /tmp/kms_events.json
Upload to s3://audit-exports/kms/{alias}/{ts}/ ; include key_arn and encrypt the bundle with the CMK, manifest signed by uploader. Maps to: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO A.10.1 (key management evidence).

leo_g: For vuln→incident (C) — key steps: export ticket, CI artifact hash, deploy trace, alert snapshots, slack bridge transcript (redacted). Example commands: 
curl -u $JIRA_API_TOKEN "https://redwood.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/$TICKET" > /tmp/ticket.json
sha256sum build/artifact.tar.gz > /tmp/artifact.sha256
curl -s "https://deploy.internal/api/v1/traces?deploy_id=$DEPLOY_ID" > /tmp/deploy_trace.json
curl -g "https://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query_range?query=ALERTS&start=1700000000&end=1700000360" > /tmp/alerts.json
/compliance/export_slack --channel incident-bridge --start 1700000000 --end 1700000360 > /tmp/slack_raw.txt && python3 /tools/redact_slack.py /tmp/slack_raw.txt /tmp/slack_redacted.txt
Upload to s3://audit-exports/incidents/{ticket}/{ts}/ ; manifest+gpg signature required. Maps to: SOC2 CC7.1 (incident response), ISO A.16.1.3 (incident evidence).

maria.chen: Retention/immutability: hot S3 365 days, Glacier-Deep 7 years. Finalized bundles get S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) and manifest signed; object metadata includes uploader, job_id, manifest_sha256, and object-lock id. Raw Slack transcripts are quarantined; only redacted copy goes to auditor.

auditor.elise: OK — please attach one sample RBAC bundle and one KMS bundle to AUD-2026-450 and include the manifest and signer info so I can validate checksums and signature verification.

sec-bot: Created audit task AUD-2026-450 and scheduled a verification window 2026-04-07T15:00:00Z.
